A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in patients with PBC, orcein and/or rubeanic acid staining of liver tissue samples can be a useful tool for the diagnosis of this disease.
the combined use of orcein, rubeanic acid and the conventional staining methods is a valuable aid to the histological diagnosis of PBC and CA.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of orcein-positive copper granules in hepatocytes is a reliable marker for the presence of PBC, but their absence is not a reliable marker for its absence.
orcein staining of liver biopsies is a valuable tool in the differential diagnosis of PBC and CA.
intrahepatocellular copper granules can be detected by orcein and/or rubeanic acid staining in most patients with PBC and in some with CAH.
